title: Comprehensive Photometry of the Rings and 16 Satellites of Uranus with the Hubble Space Telescope
location: Table IV, printed page 55 / PDF page 5
model: Adopted prolate spheroid: major axis points toward Uranus; the two perpendicular axes equal B. The third axis is a published assumption, not an independent measurement.

uncertainties.location: French et al. (2024), Table 3, PDF page 10, reproducing Karkoschka (2001) Voyager paper Table V

qualification: An analytic representation of published adopted dimensions, not resolved terrain or an archived detailed mesh. The uncertainties are on projected radius and axis ratio, not independent uncertainties on all three axes.

mass.method: Dynamical inference from forced normal-mode amplitudes: the gamma-ring 6:5 inner Lindblad resonance and epsilon outer-edge 14:13 inner Lindblad resonance.
mass.qualification: Ring-forcing inference, not the separate mass row computed with assumed 0.90 g/cm³ density. Inferred density 0.87(+0.89/−0.30)g/cm³ combines this mass with an uncertain prolate volume; it is not a directly measured composition.
